# Lokesh Ram Chand B

> Software engineer building full-stack products and AI/ML systems (backend architecture, retrieval-augmented generation, production hardening). Based in Hyderabad, India.

This site is an interactive portfolio. The links below point to crawlable, text-first resources for assistants and search engines that don't execute JavaScript.
